translation: To treat lung obstruction, open the upper lightly; to treat the spleen, one must assist with warming and freeing.

If yin and yang and exterior and interior are at variance, the true qi of the viscera drains day by day, and yin and yang do not move, so distension must also arise. Treat by freeing the yang, and only then can one achieve results, as with the bureau formula Yuyuliang Wan. Even when the three burners mutually obstruct, one must use separate-dispersing; when the intestines and stomach are blocked, one must use downward seizure.
But one must not treat it as the same case as the excess-heat of cold damage and recklessly use Xiao, Huang, Zhi, and Pu, disturbing the yin blood.
